title: kit.search-config.v1
description: project.search in site.config.js: what a project tells the global search beyond its pages. Everything is optional: without it the sections are the first path segment of every page, labelled by that section's own page, and there are no facets or synonyms.

exclude.description: Globs (relative to the output directory) of pages the search leaves out.

registry.description: A page registry (kit.page-registry.v1, buildRegistry): the sections, facets, synonyms, labels and weights then come from it.

paths.description: URL globs (/academy/**) of the pages in the section; the language prefix is not part of the path.

sections.description: Sections by rule, ahead of the ones derived from the path.

match.description: A page has the value when its path matches a glob or its title or summary has one of the words.

facets.description: Facets (audience, industry, regulation…) a result can be filtered by, as rules.

tags.description: The project's tag vocabulary as a search facet (kit.content-tags.v1; build it with searchFacet from @saasreport/core/tags): pages name their tags in <meta name="kit:tags" content="id id">.

synonyms.description: Groups of words the search treats as one (Persian and Latin spellings of one term, an abbreviation and its name).
